visual_evidence: The lamed of the central לנו has a detached round dark dot inside its lower bowl, clearly separate from its outline. Beneath it is a horizontal vowel bar with a short descending central stroke (qamats), and a separate tall vertical stroke to the left of that vowel (meteg). The final vav has its detached shuruq dot.
